name: CATS benchmark
description: A competition-style benchmark (CATS) for time series prediction intended to evaluate and compare forecasting algorithms.
reputation: A competition-style benchmark from the forecasting community (2007) that has moderate citation in time-series literature but is not widely used in modern deep-learning benchmark suites.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; relatively small and older dataset—performance sensitive to preprocessing and non-stationarity; potential for dataset-specific tuning/contamination.
